propositions: Rebar fails to sync Jira status when the workflow forbids a direct transition and only allows intermediate hops (e.g., open→in_progress→done instead of open→done).
The direct transition attempt raises RuntimeError (Cloud) or ValueError (DC) and causes the ticket to drift with a comment fallback.
Replay should walk the recorded sequence of intermediate status hops in chronological order from *-STATUS.json events, forward-mapped to Jira names, to reach the target state.
Replay must resume from the current Jira status (fetched via get_issue) by matching it in Jira-name space without inverting LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA; on ambiguity anchor to the last occurrence.
Replay aborts and falls through to comment-fallback if any hop raises RuntimeError, ValueError, IllegalTransitionError, or HTTPError; no partial hops are retried.
Implementation adds local_id parameter to _update_one_scalar_update, calls replay_transition before comment-fallback, and keeps dispatch_one.py under the 800-LOC policy cap.
